worker: al`, `printed`.
- **Tests:**
  - New `src/money.test.js` covers the 3 × 35 order (105, 16, 18, 107), the half-up 30-cent case, zero discount and tax, and quantity above 1.
  - `src/cart/total.test.js` gets the two regression tests (107 and 30).
  - `src/invoice/invoice.test.js` gets the 35-cent invoice test and an agreement test that `cartTotal(order)` equals `buildInvoice(order).total`. The agreement test covers three quantity-1 lines, one quantity-3 line, the 30-cent order, and a multi-line mixed-price order.
  - The two existing tests are unchanged.

My first attempt, writing the files through a shell command, was denied, so I redid it with the file tools. Only files under `src/` changed.
